topologies.DE_RE_JUMPER: A removable two-pin shunt connects the isolated control output to the permanently paired MAX485 DE and /RE pins; its absence is safe because the paired net has a field-side pull-down.
topologies.FIELD_TERMINAL: The three-position WJ126 terminal exposes only MAX485 A, B, and GND_FIELD.
topologies.ISOLATED_RS485: A 5 V logic header crosses TX, RX, and shared DE/RE control through a 2-forward/1-reverse ADuM1301 isolator. A separate 5 V-to-9 V isolated converter followed only on the field side by a 5 V LDO powers MAX485 and the field-side isolator supply.

assumptions: C1 is U1 logic-side bypass, C2 is U1 field-side bypass, and C3 is U2 bypass. C4 is B0509 input bypass; C5 is B0509 output bypass; C6 and C7 are AMS1117 input and output capacitors.

R1 holds the combined DE_RE_FIELD net low when the shunt is absent or the isolator is unpowered, disabling the driver and enabling the MAX485 receiver. The ADuM1301 A-grade default output is also selected low for powered-up safe control behavior.

R2 is the 680 Ohm +9V_FIELD bleeder. At 9 V it draws 13.24 mA and dissipates 119 mW; even at the +10% 9.9 V envelope it dissipates 144 mW, below its 250 mW rating. It independently clears the B0509S-1WR3 specified 11.2 mA minimum load, so this candidate does not rely on host traffic for regulation.
The B0509S-1WR3 is not a direct 5 V MAX485 supply. U4 regulates its isolated +9V_FIELD output to +5V_FIELD; U4 is rated for 15 V input and MAX485 is limited to 4.75-5.25 V.
The logic header carries only a 5 V-compatible UART/control interface. Do not attach a 3.3 V host without an upstream 5 V-level-compatible buffer.

topologies.STEPPER: A4988 current-regulated 12 V bipolar stepper drive with VREF sense resistor and three independently operated microstep DIP poles

assumptions: Motor supply is 12 V. The corrected recipe reference divider uses VDD=3.3 V, 33 kOhm/10 kOhm and 0.10 ohm sense resistors: VREF=3.3*10/(33+10)=0.767 V and ITRIPMAX=VREF/(8*0.10)=0.959 A.
Each DIP pole connects VDD to exactly one corrected recipe port MS1, MS2, or MS3. With a pole open, the A4988 internal pulldown selects low; no DIP pole is shared.
Thermal feasibility requires the recipe exposed-pad copper and thermal vias plus emitted-board geometry.
